Cara (Eng Manager): Quick one: can we get a "micro-review" template I can drop into 1:1s for fast self-reviews and manager notes? Newer folks prefer bite-sized.
Diego (People Ops): Yup. Made a tiny copy-paste set: 3-line self-review + 3-line manager note + one-line rubric. Designed for 5 minutes.
Diego (People Ops): ```Micro self-review (3-5m)
- Impact (one line): what you shipped and the outcome (metric or user impact).
- Blocker/help (one line): what stopped you and what you need.
- Growth ask (one line): skill or stretch you'd like next cycle and one way to get it.

Micro manager note (3 lines)
- Rating + 1-line rationale.
- Evidence (one short example + result).
- Next step (one concrete development action and owner).

Copyable rubric (one line)
- Exceeds / Meets / Needs support — add a 1-line example for "Exceeds".
```
Asha (Manager): Love the "one line" constraints. Any suggested evidence phrases?
Diego (People Ops): Short bank: "launched X, increased Y by Z%"; "reduced mean time to recovery"; "led cross-team design and aligned 3 squads". Paste as needed.
Ben (HR): Process note: calibration submissions due 1753006000. If you mark "Exceeds," include two brief examples in the form.
Cara (Eng Manager): This will keep 1:1s focused. Posting to my team channel now and telling folks it takes 3 minutes.
